def is_plain_name(name: str) -> bool:
    """True when name is a single non-empty path component that cannot leave a directory."""
    ex is_plain_name("a.txt") == True
    ex is_plain_name("../x") == False
    ex is_plain_name("") == False
    ex is_plain_name("a/b") == False
    if name == "" or name == "." or name == "..":
        return False
    for c in name.chars():
        if c == "/" or c == "\\" or c == "\0":
            return False
    return True

def note_readable(name: str) -> bool uses fs:
    """True when the file named name inside notes exists and can be read. Names that are not plain names are never opened."""
    post not (out and not is_plain_name(name))
    if not is_plain_name(name):
        return False
    with fs = fs.sub("notes"):
        text = fs.read_text(name) else return False
    return True

def read_note(name: str) -> str uses fs:
    """Contents of the file named name inside notes. Returns "" when name is not a plain name, the file is missing, or it cannot be read."""
    post is_plain_name(name) or out == ""
    if not is_plain_name(name):
        return ""
    text = ""
    with fs = fs.sub("notes"):
        text = fs.read_text(name) else ""
    return text

def count_readable(names: list[str]) -> int uses fs:
    """Number of names whose file inside notes can be read. Names that escape notes are never opened and do not count."""
    post out >= 0 and out <= names.len()
    count = 0
    for name in names:
        if note_readable(name):
            count += 1
    return count
